correctness.rationale: The nonempty difference of two perfect matchings is an alternating union of even cycles of length at least four; six vertices allow only a single 4- or 6-cycle. Conversely, alternating each such cycle and matching the unused pair in the four-cycle case constructs the two distinct matchings. All-positive traces force containment in one of these cycles. A five-edge positive support has to be the spanning path in a 6-cycle; retaining the first four edges of that path forces use of the last edge in the only Hamiltonian completion, and no 4-cycle can realize the first four. No larger set is shattered by downward closure. A four-edge subset of a cycle is either the 4-cycle or a linear forest of four edges on at most six vertices, giving exactly P5, P4 plus an edge, or two P3s. The 16 traces for a representative of each type were independently checked in the certificate, and permutation symmetry plus downward closure gives all smaller subsets contained in a cycle. Counting labelled paths and cycles gives 45, 360, 180, 90 respectively. All pairs are admissible; a triple is admissible exactly unless it is a star or triangle (any three-edge linear forest can extend to a spanning cycle), yielding 455−60−20=375. The fresh exhaustive replay generated the 15 perfect matchings and 105 concepts, tested all 32768 supports with zero iff discrepancies, checked all 64 witnesses, and gave augmented boundary ranks 1,14,91,284. Subtracting consecutive ranks from the chain dimensions gives exactly one nonzero reduced Betti number, 675−284=391 in degree three. The proof's sentence attributing direct JSON witness checking to both supplied programs overstates the C++ check; the C++ program tests traces globally without reading JSON, while the supplied Python description and the fresh replay check the certificate explicitly. The exhaustive finite result is unaffected.
residual_risks: The exhaustive census covers exactly K6 and the nonempty differences of distinct perfect matchings. The homology calculation is over F₂ only; no integral or homotopy conclusion is warranted.

evidence: Cambie–Girão–Kang bounds the allowable family size given bounded VC dimension of a repeated set operation, not the collection of traces for perfect matchings.

value.rationale: K6 is the first even complete graph where nonempty perfect-matching differences include both short and spanning cycles, and the last before two disjoint alternating cycles become possible at order eight. Thus it is a meaningful cutoff for the trace effect of adding short cycles. The VC dimension alone misses 315 extra facets and the changed set of allowed support types. The full shape and exact mod-two invariant give a usable baseline for comparisons with spanning-only or multi-component concept families, rather than a numerical recomputation of the known dimension.
residual_risks: The finite baseline does not predict an all-order classification or identify an integral homotopy type.
